name: Error 2351
storyline:
Investigate the environment and enter Ridgecourt Forest, classified as extremely dangerous. Since the last police raid, killed people and missing officers have still not been found. Noone has ever tried to enter the area, expect Silas, a young detective and former police officer. His daughter has gone missing 4 months ago, locals reported several strange activities including female voices and screams. Entering the abandoned Asylum, lurking in the deep dark of Ridgecourt's Forest, is the only possible way to rescue his daughter.
Police say that Jake Kron, a scientist known for his strange and crazy scientifical experiments, still lives and works in the abandoned asylum. Investigations indicate that he uses human beings, mostly desperate and poor ones, for his experiments. Silas is the only one brave enough to enter the asylum. His equipment, including a gun and a flashlight, quickly proves to be useless.
summary: A 3D first-person horror game of survival and exploration. As a former police officer, you search abandoned halls and buildings, solve environmental puzzles, and evade the horror of scientists haunting Ridgecourt Forest. By uncovering hidden clues, you’ll piece together the truth behind the mystery.
